whatIs: Magic UI is a library of more than 150 animated components and effects, built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Motion, that complements shadcn/ui. It includes pieces such as animated text, backgrounds, marquees, and shiny buttons, designed to bring landing pages to life.
It's a good fit when you want a product page to look polished and have motion without coding every animation.
uses: Adding an animated background and a title with an effect to a landing page's hero.
Showing customer logos in a marquee that scrolls on its own.
Adding buttons and cards with shine effects to a launch page.
caveats: It's designed for React projects with Tailwind; it doesn't work as-is in other frameworks.
Many effects use Motion, which adds to your project's dependencies.
The complete templates and blocks are in Magic UI Pro, which is paid.
pricingNote: The components are free and open source (MIT); Magic UI Pro sells blocks and templates for $199 as a one-time payment.
idealFor: Teams with React and Tailwind that want animated landing pages without so much work.
